dialogue.content: こんばんは。よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Good evening. It's nice to meet you.

dialogue.content: こんばんは。よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Good evening. It's nice to meet you too.

dialogue.content: 30分になりましたらお声掛けさせていただきますね。
dialogue.English: I'll let you know when our 30 minutes are up.

dialogue.content: はいお願いします。
dialogue.English: Okay, thank you.

dialogue.content: こんばんは。本日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Good evening. What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: 去年の出来事なんですけど聞いてもらえますか？
dialogue.English: It's about something that happened last year. Is it okay if I talk about it?

dialogue.content: はい、よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Yes, please go ahead.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 去年のことですね。どうされましたか？
dialogue.English: Something from last year, I see. What happened?

dialogue.content: 去年の体育祭のクラスリレーの順番決めの時に
dialogue.English: When we were deciding the running order for the class relay at last year's sports festival,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 実行委員の友達からどうしてもトップで走ってって言われて
dialogue.English: a friend on the committee insisted that I run the first leg.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Uh-huh.

dialogue.content: すごく嫌だったので無理って言ったんです
dialogue.English: I really didn't want to, so I said I couldn't.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: でも、なんでか絶対ゆっちゃんが走って！って言われてしまって
dialogue.English: But for some reason, they kept saying, "Yucchan, you absolutely have to run!"

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: 最初に走る人の実力で絶対に差ができるから他のクラスはみんな男子なんです。
dialogue.English: The first runner's ability makes a huge difference, so all the other classes had boys running first.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。
dialogue.English: Oh, I see.

dialogue.content: なのに、私にって言ってきて…
dialogue.English: And yet, they insisted it had to be me...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Right.

dialogue.content: 男子にもサッカー部の人とか速い人はたくさんいるんです
dialogue.English: There are plenty of fast boys, like the ones in the soccer club.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Uh-huh.

dialogue.content: 自分だって部長やってて私より速いのにすごく押し付けてきて
dialogue.English: The committee member is the captain and faster than me, but they really pushed it on me.

dialogue.content: はい。それは、プレッシャーを感じてしまいますよね。
dialogue.English: Yes. That must have been a lot of pressure.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: それでもゆっちゃんは、走ったんですよね。
dialogue.English: And yet, you did end up running, didn't you, Yucchan?

dialogue.content: はい走りました
dialogue.English: Yes, I ran.

dialogue.content: ゆっちゃんは、今おいくつですか？
dialogue.English: How old are you now, Yucchan?

dialogue.content: 今は15才です中2の時の話で
dialogue.English: I'm 15 now. This was when I was in eighth grade.

dialogue.content: 教えてくれてありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you for telling me.

dialogue.content: 同じクラスの幼なじみみたいな男子が、俺たちですぐつないで走るからがんばれって言ってくれて
dialogue.English: A boy in my class who's like a childhood friend told me, "We'll catch up right away, so just do your best."

dialogue.content: そんなプレッシャーの中、よく頑張りましたね。
dialogue.English: You did so well to persevere under all that pressure.

dialogue.content: はい。それ以上嫌っていえなくて😭でも、その後おかしくなってしまいました
dialogue.English: Yes. I couldn't say no anymore. 😭 But after that, things started to go wrong.

dialogue.content: すぐ後にテニス部の大会があって
dialogue.English: Right after that, there was a tennis club tournament,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: その、部長の子とペアだったので本当はすっごく嫌で嫌で行きたくなかったんですけど
dialogue.English: I was paired with that captain, so honestly, I really, really didn't want to go.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: 私は小学生の頃からテニスをやっていたのでお母さん達がすごく応援してくれてて
dialogue.English: I've been playing tennis since elementary school, so my parents were really supportive,

dialogue.content: やっぱり嫌って言えなくて
dialogue.English: so in the end, I couldn't say I didn't want to go.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。
dialogue.English: I see how it was.

dialogue.content: あんまり食べられないし全然楽しくないし
dialogue.English: I couldn't eat much, and nothing felt fun at all.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。それは辛かったですね。食べられない、とは具体的にどんな感じだったのですか？
dialogue.English: I see. That must have been difficult. When you say you couldn't eat, what was that like specifically?

dialogue.content: それでもお母さんもお父さんも車で送り迎えしてくれるのでとにかく普通にしなくちゃってやってて
dialogue.English: Even so, my mom and dad drove me to and from, so I felt I had to act normal no matter what.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 食欲がなかったので…
dialogue.English: I just didn't have an appetite...

dialogue.content: やはり気がかりで、食欲がなかったのですね。
dialogue.English: It sounds like you were so worried that you lost your appetite.

dialogue.content: それはしんどかったですよね。
dialogue.English: That must have been really tough.

dialogue.content: 後から聞いたら12キロ痩せてました
dialogue.English: I learned later that I'd lost 12 kilograms.

dialogue.content: え？そんなに・・・
dialogue.English: What? That much...

dialogue.content: それで、クリスマス前に病院に連れて行かれて
dialogue.English: Then, I was taken to the hospital before Christmas,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 強制入院です
dialogue.English: and I was admitted involuntarily.

dialogue.content: それは大変辛かったですね・・
dialogue.English: That must have been incredibly difficult for you...

dialogue.content: ご両親も心配なさったでしょうね‥
dialogue.English: Your parents must have been so worried...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: すごく心配かけちゃいけないって思ってたのに
dialogue.English: Even though I was trying so hard not to make them worry.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: でも学校行かなくてよくなって嬉しかった
dialogue.English: But I was happy that I didn't have to go to school anymore.

dialogue.content: そんな風に思うほど、考えてしまっていて・・辛かったですよね・・
dialogue.English: To feel that way... you must have been thinking about it so much. It must have been so hard for you...

dialogue.content: それから退院してもやっぱり心配かけてて悪いなーって
dialogue.English: Even after I was discharged, I still felt bad for making them worry.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: ご両親もそれはご心配だったでしょうね・・
dialogue.English: Your parents must have been very worried...

dialogue.content: そうなんです無理して明るくしてる感じ
dialogue.English: That's right. I feel like I'm forcing myself to be cheerful.

dialogue.content: それは頑張っているんですね・・
dialogue.English: It sounds like you're trying so hard...

dialogue.content: ご両親に心配をこれ以上かけたくないと、思っておらっしゃるんですよね・・
dialogue.English: You're thinking that you don't want to worry your parents any more, aren't you...

dialogue.content: その後、しばらく学校をお休みして、でも夏休み明けから行けるようになりました。
dialogue.English: After that, I took a break from school for a while, but I was able to go back after summer vacation.

dialogue.content: 失礼しました。いっらしゃる、の間違いでした。
dialogue.English: My apologies. I made a typo.

dialogue.content: 学校生活は戻ることが出来たのですね。
dialogue.English: So you were able to return to your school life.

dialogue.content: はい。今日、相談したいのはあの時断ればよかったってどうしても気になってるんです
dialogue.English: Yes. What I want to talk about today is that I can't stop thinking that I should have refused back then.

dialogue.content: 部長はすごくしっかりしててみんなにも頼りにされてるのに
dialogue.English: The captain is really reliable and everyone depends on them, and yet...

dialogue.content: ええ。そのことが気になっているのですね。
dialogue.English: I see. That's what's been on your mind.

dialogue.content: なんであんな事言ったんだろうって・・・
dialogue.English: I wonder why they said something like that...

dialogue.content: それは、嫌と断れなかったことですよね。
dialogue.English: You're referring to not being able to say no, right?

dialogue.content: はい。走者の順番です
dialogue.English: Yes. About the running order.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: 男子の早い子が走るのなら、そのことを相談したかったですよね。
dialogue.English: If a fast boy was supposed to run, you wanted to be able to discuss that, right?

dialogue.content: 担任がいつも私をイジるっていうか
dialogue.English: My homeroom teacher always kind of picks on me,

dialogue.content: はい、それも1年で見てるからみんな分かってます
dialogue.English: Yes, and everyone knows it because they've seen it for a year.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。担任がどのようにゆっちゃんをいじってくるのですか？
dialogue.English: I see. In what ways does your teacher pick on you, Yucchan?

dialogue.content: 先生も話し合いにいて聞かれて最初嫌って言ったんですけど
dialogue.English: The teacher was there during the discussion, and when they asked me, I said no at first.

dialogue.content: お前は顔が暗いとか
dialogue.English: Things like, "You look so gloomy."

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: お前だけ笑ってないぞ〜とか
dialogue.English: Or "You're the only one not smiling~"

dialogue.content: ええ？
dialogue.English: What?

dialogue.content: そんなことを・・
dialogue.English: To say such things...

dialogue.content: なにかとツッコミのネタというかそれで他のみんなの笑いをとってる感じ
dialogue.English: It's like I'm the butt of the joke, and they use me to get laughs from everyone else.

dialogue.content: それは、ひどいですよね・・ゆっちゃん一人で笑うしかなくて辛かったですよね・・
dialogue.English: That's awful... It must have been hard for you to have to laugh it off alone...

dialogue.content: 笑いたくないから笑ってなかったのに笑われるネタにされた？
dialogue.English: I wasn't smiling because I didn't want to, but that just turned me into a joke for them to laugh at?

dialogue.content: おもしろくないんです
dialogue.English: It's not funny.

dialogue.content: そのように思ってしまったのですね・・
dialogue.English: So that's how it made you feel...

dialogue.content: ネタにされたと思うと、悲しくなってしまいなすよね・・
dialogue.English: It must be so saddening to feel like you were made into a joke...

dialogue.content: そうなんです！それからみんなとあんまり気軽に話せない気がして
dialogue.English: Exactly! Since then, I feel like I can't really talk casually with everyone.

dialogue.content: それはかなりしんどいですよね・・そのクラスにゆっちゃんの友達とかはいますか？
dialogue.English: That must be really hard... Do you have any friends in that class, Yucchan?

dialogue.content: 1人いたんですけど私より先に学校に来なくなってました
dialogue.English: I had one, but they stopped coming to school before I did.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。仲のいい友達が学校に来なくなって、ゆっちゃんも不安でしたよね・・
dialogue.English: I see. When your good friend stopped coming to school, you must have felt anxious too, Yucchan...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: いまは気軽にクラスメイトと話せなくなってしまって、居場所がない、なんて思ってしまいますよね・・
dialogue.English: Now that you can't talk casually with your classmates, it must feel like you don't have a place there...

dialogue.content: あ、でも今はクラス替えがあって仲のいい子もいます
dialogue.English: Oh, but we've changed classes now, and I have some good friends.

dialogue.content: その先生も他の学校にいなくなりました
dialogue.English: And that teacher transferred to another school.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: クラス替えで友達も出来て、それは良かったです。
dialogue.English: I'm glad you were able to make friends after the class change.

dialogue.content: 普通、まじめに勝ちたいと思ったら女子を1番に入れるのはおかしいってまともな先生なら私の意見を聞いてくれると思うんですけど
dialogue.English: Normally, if you seriously want to win, putting a girl in the first position is strange. I think a reasonable teacher would have listened to my opinion.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: はい、今は普通に行けてます。ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Yes, I can go to school normally now. Thank you.

dialogue.content: 部長ともう1人、実行委員がグルになってどうしてもゆっちゃんで！っておしてきて
dialogue.English: The captain and another committee member ganged up on me, pushing and saying, "It has to be Yucchan!"

dialogue.content: はい。それはよかったです。でも、その先生は全く意見を聞いてくれなかったのですよね。
dialogue.English: Yes, that's good to hear. But that teacher didn't listen to your opinion at all, did they?

dialogue.content: はい。はしれるやろ！嫌か？って言われて
dialogue.English: Right. They said, "You can run, can't you! You don't want to?"

dialogue.content: ええ！？そんなことを・・
dialogue.English: What!? They said that...?

dialogue.content: 泣きながらはいって頷いてしまいました
dialogue.English: While crying, I nodded and said yes.

dialogue.content: でも、走るっていう返事をしたことになってて
dialogue.English: But it was taken as me agreeing to run.

dialogue.content: それは、つらかったですよね・・だって押し付けられたようなものですよね・・
dialogue.English: That must have been so painful... It's like you were forced into it...

dialogue.content: もう、どうしたらいいかわからなくて
dialogue.English: I just didn't know what to do anymore.

dialogue.content: 案の定、他のクラスはみんな男子でした
dialogue.English: And just as I expected, all the other classes had boys running first.

dialogue.content: 泣いていて、頷いたところを勘違いされて、ゆっちゃんもパニックですよね・・
dialogue.English: They must have misunderstood you nodding while crying. You must have been in a panic, Yucchan...

dialogue.content: そうです
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: しかもクラスの雰囲気もそんな感じならなおさら引くに引けないし、でもやりたくないしで、かなしくなりますよね・・
dialogue.English: And with the class atmosphere like that, it must have been even harder to back down. But you didn't want to do it, which is just so sad...

dialogue.content: はいもう本当に嫌でした
dialogue.English: Yes, I really, really hated it.

dialogue.content: それはすごく傷つきますし、腹も立ってしまいますよね・・
dialogue.English: That must have been very hurtful, and it must have made you angry too...

dialogue.content: はい困って親に言ったんですけど
dialogue.English: Yes, I was stuck, so I told my parents,

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Uh-huh.

dialogue.content: でも決まったならがんばればって言われて
dialogue.English: but they just said, "Well, if it's decided, then you should just do your best."

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: はい・・・
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: せっかく相談したのに、悲しかったですよね。
dialogue.English: You finally spoke up about it, so it must have been sad to hear that.

dialogue.content: うーん、そうなんですかね。。
dialogue.English: Hmm, I wonder if that's it...

dialogue.content: やるしかないのか、、、って思いました
dialogue.English: I just thought, "I guess I have no choice but to do it."

dialogue.content: 悲しい、というよりやるしかない、と思ったのですね。
dialogue.English: So rather than feeling sad, you felt you had no other choice.

dialogue.content: いきさつを聞いてもらってそれなら走るしかないねって言われたのではい、悲しいとかはなくて
dialogue.English: They listened to the whole story and then said, "Well, then you have no choice but to run," so no, it wasn't really about being sad.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 悲しい、というより、聞いてもらえてやるしかない、と思って走ったのですね。
dialogue.English: So it wasn't so much sadness, but more that you felt they listened, and you just had to do it, so you ran.

dialogue.content: 全然自信なかったですけど後には引けないんだっていう気持ちだけでした
dialogue.English: I had no confidence at all, but I just felt like I couldn't back down.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。ゆっちゃんは辛かったけど一生懸命取り組んだのですね。
dialogue.English: I see. It was difficult for you, Yucchan, but you still tried your very best.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。お時間になりましたので、ここで終了させていただきます。
dialogue.English: Thank you very much. Our time is up, so we will end our session here.

dialogue.content: はい！ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Okay! Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: モランさん、ありがとうございました。また機会がありましたら、よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Thank you, Moran-san. I hope to have the opportunity to speak with you again.

dialogue.content: はいたくさん聴いていただいてありがとうございました。こちらこそよろしくお願い致します。
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you so much for listening. I look forward to it as well.
